positive_snippets:
We had a wonderful stay at Treebo MVM Residency! Even though we are from Kerala, we felt completely at home here. The hospitality of the staff was truly commendable — they were friendly, polite, and always ready to help with a smile. The rooms were very clean and well-maintained, and the food service was excellent.

They even helped us with local shopping arrangements and made sure we had everything we needed during our stay. Overall, it was a very comfortable and pleasant experience. Highly recommended! 🌟
Sajitha

Greetings

Stay Duration:-21 August 2025
Room Type: Deluxe Room

I had a pleasant stay at the hotel Treebo MVM Residency The room was spacious, clean, and well-maintained, with a comfortable bed.
The air conditioning worked well, and the Wi-Fi was fast and reliable, which was important for my work.

The bathroom was spotless, and I appreciated the quality toiletries provided. However, the shower pressure could have been a bit stronger.

Hotel staff were friendly and attentive, and check-in/check-out was smooth. I also appreciated the quick room service in early morning Tea & Toast supplies in the room.

Overall, it was a very comfortable and convenient experience. I would definitely consider staying here again.

Being a Well Wisher One small suggestion would be to add more Towels in the Bathroom & One Water Bottal in the Room.

Bestwishes
Vikas Mongia
negative_snippets:
I recently stayed at this hotel and would like to share some my feedback.

The room was compact, but the washroom was clean and well maintained, which I appreciated. The manager was polite and supportive, and handled our concerns patiently when contacted.

There is scope for improvement in service response time, especially during late hours, as it was a little difficult to reach the hotel by phone initially. Clarifying whether the property functions as a hotel or hostel in advance would also help avoid confusion for guests.

Regarding food, the breakfast options were limited and not good at all after ordering i realised its waste of money , and the pricing of snacks like Maggi felt higher than expected. Improving food quality and offering better value would greatly enhance the guest experience.

Overall, with some improvements in service communication and food offerings, this place has the potential to provide a better stay.

No cleaning was done before we arrived. The room was much smaller than what was shown online. The pillows were dirty, and there was hair and dust on the bed. We only stayed because it was just for one night - then after request they have provided us the clean room.

Just an "okay" hotel that doesn't deliver on promises. They advertise amenities like electric kettle and free toiletries but don't provide them. When asked, staff says "people steal so we don't give" - at ₹3,000/night, they should afford replacements.

Charged extra ₹1,000 for early check-in at 8 AM, only to get a room with stained bedsheets, dirty quilt covers, stained pillows, and broken toilet flush. When complained, they changed bedsheets but new ones were also poor quality. Promised quilt cover replacement "once laundry comes" - took until 9 PM.

Multiple requests for basic amenities met with "reception not available, will provide later" excuses. Poor follow-through on service.

**Bottom line**: Why advertise what you can't provide and overcharge for subpar service? Think twice before booking. Only consider if you absolutely must stay in this area and have no other options. Don't expect good cleanliness or service standards.
